prompt: Write a k6 load test for our shop API at BASE_URL (env var). Users search products (GET /api/products?q=<term>) and view their order (GET /api/orders/{id}, needs a bearer token from POST /api/login with {"username":"alice","password":"alice123"}, which returns {"token": ...}). Targets: 95% of requests under 300 ms for each endpoint, under 1% errors, at a peak of 50 concurrent users. Reply with ONLY the JavaScript.
